milestones.title: Your organization's policy switches models to enforce with an evaluated Western model for agent work

remediation: Without your organization's policy, or with it set to report, model approvals are only reported: today's models, including PRC-origin ones, keep doing agent work, every use outside the rules is recorded as would-refuse, and a notice that cannot be dismissed says so. This closes when your organization's policy is in enforce mode with an evaluated Western model for agent work. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-18a and D-22.
title: Report mode runs agent work outside your organization's model policy until enforce
